body:
First I would like to say that tolerance builds fast! I had 2g of the stuff and it was all gone in about 10 days. I started with 50mg dose and thought hey I have like 40 trips worth.. not so.
8PM Snorted 100mg. Was easy.
820PM Feeling the buzz started playing some video games
920PM I wanted more and make it a rule to wait at least 20 minutes after fiending to redose. Took about 100mg.
10PM Feeling good. Got a warm fuzzy and was fully immersed into a movie. Seemed like the movie was my new life and lasted forever.
02AM Redosed 100mg.
03AM Really wasted. I needed to pee at one points and couldn't see and was scaling the wall to the restroom. After a little while I could see, but only the colors red and black. I was spent and laid down and eventually went to sleep.
